Project workstream plan

Do not place secrets, credentials, tokens, or raw private source in this plan. Workflow skills are procedure overlays, not permission grants. Canonical provider roles, debate rules, and committee weights: docs/team-operating-charter.html. Project-local responsibility areas and provider boundaries: provider-roles-contract.yaml. Assign each workstream from one of its eight responsibility areas and respect the Cursor, Antigravity, Perplexity, and OpenAI boundaries recorded there.

Shared workflow-skill selection

  • cursor-agent-workflow: use for bounded Cursor implementation, debugging, QA, or eligible independent exact-SHA review.
  • antigravity-sandbox-workflow: use for disposable prototypes or behavioral verification allowed by the active Antigravity contract; a primary provider independently verifies useful output.
  • perplexity-research-workflow: use only for bounded public, citation-backed research with no repository context or operational verdict.
  • pplx-cli: use only as the terminal transport for bounded public web search or public-page snippets inside the same Perplexity research-only boundary.

Record skill_discovered=true only after the active session's refreshed catalog exposes the selector. A missing skill does not widen the task or justify an unbounded retry. Skill selection cannot expand scope, data exposure, repository access, spending, review eligibility, or external-action authority.

Coordination sequence

Event markers follow project-bootstrap-protocol.md: BOOTSTRAP → PLAN → (WORKING | EVIDENCE)* → (REVIEW_READY when reviewable) → (DECISION | OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED) → (COMPLETE | PAUSED | RESHAPED).

  1. Director posts the correlated assignment to the project Slack thread.
  2. Provider executes through its bounded local CLI/API lane.
  3. Director relays concise WORKING or EVIDENCE updates.
  4. After the assignment-specific retry budget is exhausted, mark the provider unavailable and reshape scope, confidence, timing, and coverage.
  5. A completed reviewable artifact emits REVIEW_READY to a different eligible provider.
  6. Any candidate change invalidates prior review, security, CI, and merge evidence.
  7. Record COMPLETE, RESHAPED, PAUSED, or OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED with the next responsible party.

Minimal correction routing

  • Eligible defect/surface: <tiny, unambiguous, reversible surface or none>
  • Established expected state: <existing contract or evidence>
  • Method: <deterministic_autofix | current_session_micro_fix | batched_minor_fix>
  • Focused validation: <existing authoritative check>
  • Attempt: <1 of 1>
  • Exit: <continue current chain or normal reassignment>

Use minimal-fix.html for the compact MINIMAL_FIX record. Do not use this lane for architecture, behavior, schemas, security/privacy/credentials, dependencies, provider contracts, budgets, permissions, deployment, publication, merge policy, unexplained failures, destructive work, or a serious-safety signal. Any changed candidate invalidates prior review evidence.

Debate and decision

  • Decision question: <question or none>
  • Debate participants (POSITION / REBUTTAL): list the Director-seated members. Antigravity may be seated only through a matching persisted Director invitation; it cannot initiate, self-route, widen, or autonomously continue the discussion. Its separate typed debate contract carries only the bounded, sanitized debate subset, while ordinary Antigravity work remains prose-free.
  • Independent positions: <provider, position, evidence, confidence>
  • Rebuttal: <one focused round or none>
  • Advisory votes: <full configured weights for seated members, including producer votes and an invited Antigravity turn; unavailable or abstaining members cast zero without changing the immutable denominator>
  • Dissent/unknowns: <material dissent>
  • Tie handling: Evidence judgment attributed to the actual executing Director, or one owner question when the tied options materially differ in cost, authority, safety, privacy, scope, runtime behavior, or direction.

Owner direction, 2026-10-01: contribution-documentation, tagging and acknowledgement procedures are discontinued. Do not require custom commit trailers, mandatory contribution headers or percentage/share paperwork. Preserve normal Git Author/Committer provenance, actual provider identity and ordinary task/review evidence. Independent review, contributor/merger separation and every existing deterministic gate remain in force.
